[EN] Sikander's Bane
[ES] Azote de Sikander
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Sonacria to help you locate the ritual.
[ES] Pídele a Sonacria que te ayude a localizar el ritual.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Amena Quatla—Sanctum of Resurrection Entrance
[ES] Amena Quatla: Entrada al Sanctum of Resurrection
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] It seems to be a teleportal to the Sanctum of Resurrection.
[ES] Parece ser un telepuerto hacia el Sanctum of Resurrection.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Climb the steps of the Temple of Sikander and look for a way to the sanctum.
[ES] Sube los escalones del Temple of Sikander y busca un camino hacia el santuario.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Sanctum of Resurrection
[ES] Sanctum of Resurrection
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] What kind of place is this?
[ES] ¿Qué clase de lugar es este?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Travel to the sanctum through the {@LinkCreature:257#1501#teleportal}.
[ES] Viaja al santuario a través del {@LinkCreature:257#1501#teleportal}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Right. Okay."
[ES] "Bien. De acuerdo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Avatar of Kaia.
[ES] Habla con la Avatar of Kaia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This ritual must succeed!
[ES] ¡Este ritual debe tener éxito!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] No! The ritual...
[ES] ¡No! El ritual...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Sikander! Hear us!
[ES] ¡Sikander! ¡Escúchanos!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] So...close...
[ES] Tan... cerca...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] No! We won't fail, not after so long!
[ES] ¡No! ¡No fallaremos, no después de tanto tiempo!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Sikander...please forgive...
[ES] Sikander... por favor, perdona...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Sikander! Give me strength!
[ES] ¡Sikander! ¡Dame fuerza!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Curse you! Curse...you all...
[ES] ¡Maldición! Malditos... malditos todos...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate the sikandari priests. Stop the ritual! [The priests will not take damage if the guards keep their food.]
[ES] Elimina a los sacerdotes sikandaris. ¡Detén el ritual! [Los sacerdotes no recibirán daño si los guardias se quedan con su comida.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Isrenia!"
[ES] "¡Isrenia!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Protect Isrenia until she is ready.
[ES] Protege a Isrenia hasta que esté lista.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat Kelsaik! [Kelsaik's HP has been reduced. This quest may proceed abnormally when Kelsaik is defeated.]
[ES] ¡Derrota a Kelsaik! [El HP de Kelsaik se ha reducido. Esta misión podría continuar de forma anormal al derrotar a Kelsaik.]
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] ...I can't...
[ES] ...No puedo...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Avatar of Kaia.
[ES] Habla con la Avatar of Kaia.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Let's go."
[ES] "Vámonos."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Avatar of Kaia again.
[ES] Habla con Avatar of Kaia de nuevo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I understand."
[ES] "Entiendo".
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak to Kaia in Kaiator Command Center
[ES] Habla con Kaia en Kaiator Command Center.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
